Name: Chest Lock
Author: sakinolemir
Description:
[center][url=https://ibb.co/p6CQzPcH][/url][left][size=5] Ever seen a friend just steal items from a chest you placed on your farm? Pretty annoying... this fixes that. [/size][/left]
[left][size=5]
Craft a Locked Chests and once it's placed, you're owner. Open lock menu from chest screen, flip it to locked, and pick exactly who else gets in from your friends. Nobody else touches it, and only you can pickaxe it open if you want it gone. 

All chest variants are available, but you get them same way as their vanilla chests; you can craft Chest from day one, while Big Chest recipe has to be bought from Robin.

Works fine in split-screen, supports gamepad input, and ships with translations in 12 languages that switch automatically based on your game's language settings.[/size][/left]
